action.objective: : Verify Qxe5 recapturing the knight, winning material and centralizing the queen, then commit.
action.rationale: : After 14...Ne5 the broad depth-3 search ranks e2e5 first with an exact 606 (PV Qxe5 Qa3 Nb2 Qxa2 Qxc5 regaining pawns). It wins a full knight for free since f7 king cannot recapture and no other Black piece attacks e5. This is a concrete material gain, not imagined compensation. Verify this single candidate at full depth before committing.
